title: Policy issued and welcome
description: Welcome new policyholders on WhatsApp once a policy is issued, with policy number and start date. Transactional utility template.
notes: Link to the document portal instead of attaching files; media headers need an approved sample and slow review.

body.text: Welcome, {{first_name}}! Your {{policy_type}} policy *{{policy_no}}* is active from {{start_date}}. Your documents are ready to download any time.
